# BGET — roster & recruiting tracker

> One file, three tables. Plain text works; Notion/Sheets work too.
> **5 minutes, once a week** — required by [PLAN-90-DAYS.md](../PLAN-90-DAYS.md).

---

## 1. People (everyone who's in)

| Name | Contact | Joined | Stage | Trial check* | Last touch | Notes |
|------|---------|--------|-------|--------------|------------|-------|
| | | | | | | |

\* Stage: `invited → applied → conversation → trial → confirmed → alumni`

\* Trial check (all five, [MEMBERSHIP.md](../MEMBERSHIP.md) §4):
intro posted · 2 meaningful threads · helped someone · attended event or
contributed async · no conduct issues

---

## 2. Pipeline (people you're courting)

| Person | Source¹ | First contact | Rung² | Next action + date | Status |
|--------|---------|---------------|-------|--------------------|--------|

¹ `collab / peer-ask / community / content / referral`
² Rung 1–5 from [RECRUITING.md](../RECRUITING.md) §3

**Hard rules:**

- Every open row has a **next action with a date**. No silent stalls.
- Rows older than 14 days with no action get closed or reactivated —
  deliberately, not by drift.
- Open approaches ≤ your capacity to answer everything within 24h
  ([RECRUITING.md](../RECRUITING.md) §5).

---

## 3. Weekly funnel (one row per week)

| Week | Engaged | Approached | Replied | Conversations | Applied | Accepted | Active at 30d |
|------|---------|------------|---------|---------------|---------|----------|---------------|
| | | | | | | | |

**The last column is the score.** Accepted-but-inactive means fix retention
before recruiting ([GROWTH.md](../GROWTH.md)).

---

## 4. Weekly review (5 minutes)

- [ ] Every introduction answered within 24h? (target: always)
- [ ] Every application answered within 72h? (target: always)
- [ ] Every pipeline row has a next action + date?
- [ ] Approaches this week ≤ capacity?
- [ ] Anyone confirmed whose 30-day trial is due for review?
- [ ] One thing to stop doing?
